shared_elements: representation of a head with eyes, nose and mouth
justification: The only real correspondence is that both include a human-like head with schematically rendered eyes, nose and mouth (A as a single sculpted head in the round, B as small heads in the upper register of a relief pillar). Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a single isolated face with no accompanying figures or scene, whereas B is a multi-register relief crowded with quadrupeds, a bird in profile, a snake-like or plant-like motif and a band of repeated hatched signs, arranged in stacked horizontal registers.
